items.name: ascii-renderer
items.title: ASCII Renderer
items.description: OGL WebGL image rendered as animated ASCII dot-grid characters with scanline displacement.

items.name: card-3d
items.title: Card 3D
items.description: OGL-powered 3D card with rounded corners and mouse-tracking parallax rotation.

items.name: dithered-image
items.title: Dithered Image
items.description: OGL WebGL dithered image renderer with Bayer, halftone and void-and-cluster threshold maps.

items.name: fake-3d-image
items.title: Fake 3D Image
items.description: OGL depth-map parallax effect — move the cursor to shift the image by a grayscale depth map.

items.name: fluid-image-reveal
items.title: Fluid Image Reveal
items.description: OGL fluid simulation used as a mask to reveal a second image beneath as you move the cursor.

items.name: fluid-simulation
items.title: Fluid Simulation
items.description: OGL GPU fluid simulation — move the cursor to paint fluid. Animates autonomously while idle.

items.name: glass-logo
items.title: Glass Logo
items.description: OGL WebGL2 glass lens over an animated procedural swirl — silhouette driven by an SVG SDF.

items.name: glass-pane
items.title: Glass Pane
items.description: OGL animated glass panel strips with refraction, chromatic aberration and wave distortion over an image.

items.name: glass-slideshow
items.title: Glass Slideshow
items.description: An OGL-powered slideshow with liquid glass image transitions, chromatic fringing, and optional autoplay. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: glitter-cloth
items.title: Glitter Cloth
items.description: An OGL shader surface with animated silk folds, glitter sparkle, and vignette depth shading. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: globe
items.title: Globe
items.description: A Fresnel-lit globe with rim glow, haloed atmosphere, land mesh detail, and marker layers for data storytelling. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: god-rays
items.title: God Rays
items.description: High-performance procedural god rays effect with customizable colors, pulsating intensity, and distortion. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: halo
items.title: Halo
items.description: Atmospheric scattering based halo effect with dynamic camera rotation and sun light simulation. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: interactive-grid
items.title: Interactive Grid
items.description: Physics-based grid simulation that distorts an image in response to cursor movement. Each grid cell tracks mouse velocity and decays back to rest over time. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: lava-lamp
items.title: Lava Lamp
items.description: Raymarched metaball blobs rendered with a smooth-min SDF and Fresnel edge lighting. Creates a fluid, organic lava lamp animation. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: neural-noise
items.title: Neural Noise
items.description: Animated CPPN-based neural noise rendered in WebGL. Produces continuously evolving organic color patterns driven by a compositional pattern-producing network. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: pixelated-image
items.title: Pixelated Image
items.description: OGL image revealer that starts as coarse blocks and sharpens to full resolution over time.

items.name: plasma-grid
items.title: Plasma Grid
items.description: Animated plasma grid effect rendered in WebGL. Creates a checkerboard grid pattern with flowing plasma noise gradients. Colors are customizable via props. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: rubiks-cube
items.title: Rubik's Cube
items.description: A 3D Rubik's Cube that continuously rotates and scrambles itself with smooth face animations. Features a Fresnel rim glow shader and interactive orbit controls. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: specular-band
items.title: Specular Band
items.description: Animated specular band effect with lens distortion and hue-shifted color palettes. Creates flowing, organic light bands with adaptive blending for different background brightness levels. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: water-ripple
items.title: Water Ripple
items.description: Interactive water ripple effect on images. Creates realistic ripple distortions that follow pointer movement with expanding wave animations. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.description: Scroll-driven sticky card stack with GSAP ScrollTrigger. Nest <motion-card-stack-item> elements inside.

items.name: flip-card-stack
items.title: Flip Card Stack
items.description: A draggable card stack where the top card snaps to the back after a threshold drag. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: flip-grid
items.title: Flip Grid
items.description: A FLIP-powered grid that animates reordering and layout changes. Framework-agnostic Custom Elements.

items.name: floating-menu
items.title: Floating Menu
items.description: A floating GSAP-powered navigation menu with staggered link reveals and animated toggle lines. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: image-trail
items.title: Image Trail
items.description: An interactive effect that spawns a trail of images following the cursor with scaling and rotation. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Framework-agnostic <motion-magnetic> Custom Element with spring physics, powered by Lit and GSAP.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Scroll-velocity-boosted infinite marquee. Vanilla Custom Element — no Lit dependency.

items.name: infinite-gallery
items.title: Infinite Gallery
items.description: A 3D gallery that endlessly scrolls through textured planes with cloth-like distortion and scroll-driven transitions. Lit Custom Element.

items.name: infinite-physics-gallery
items.title: Infinite Physics Gallery
items.description: Infinite 2-D draggable grid with physics-based momentum, edge scrolling, and support for mixed image/video cells. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: logo-carousel
items.title: Logo Carousel
items.description: Grid of logos that cycles through items with a blurred vertical swap animation. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: radial-gallery
items.title: Radial Gallery
items.description: Circular rotating image gallery. Items are evenly spaced around a ring that spins continuously. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: slideshow
items.title: Slideshow
items.description: Full-bleed image slideshow with parallax slide transitions and thumbnail navigation. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video Player
items.description: Custom video player with play/pause, a hover-expanding scrubber, mute, and GSAP Flip fullscreen expand animation.

items.name: split-hover
items.title: Split Hover
items.description: Splits text into characters and animates stacked layers on hover for a seamless swap. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: split-reveal
items.title: Split Reveal
items.description: Masks text and reveals lines, words, or characters on mount or scroll. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: stacking-words
items.title: Stacking Words
items.description: Splits text into lines and slides each line's words in from the right on scroll. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: text-loop
items.title: Text Loop
items.description: Cycles through an array of text strings with a blurred vertical slide transition. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: text-repel
items.title: Text Repel
items.description: Splits text into words or characters that repel from the pointer. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Text Scramble
items.description: Scrambles characters on hover before settling back to the original text. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

items.name: weight-wave
items.title: Weight Wave
items.description: Hover-reactive text effect that smoothly increases font weight with a falloff across neighboring characters. Requires a variable font.
